main_line: 这场战争只有一种结束方式：谁活到最后，谁赢。
main_line_en: There's only one way this war ends. Last man standing.

main_line: 我是上帝的愤怒。
main_line_en: I am the wrath of God.

main_line: 离她远点，你这该死的东西！
main_line_en: Get away from her, you bitch!

main_line: 有时候这世界美得让人受不了——我感觉心要倾出来了。
main_line_en: Sometimes there's so much beauty in the world, I feel like I can't take it... and my heart is just going to cave in.

main_line: 她们穿白衣，可没人把她们当天使。
main_line_en: They wear white — but no one treats them as angels.

main_line: 四月的风，把人吹到东京。
main_line_en: An April wind blows a person all the way to Tokyo.

main_line: 暗杀名单上的人，未必比执行的人更知道自己为何而战。
main_line_en: Those on the assassination list may know no better than the killers why they are fighting.
main_character: 安玉润／韩国独立军等 / Ahn Ok-yun et al.

main_line: 她失踪以后，留下的不是线索，是彼此之间忽然空出来的距离。
main_line_en: After she vanished, what remained was not a clue — but a sudden distance between them.
main_character: 桑德罗／克劳迪娅 / Sandro / Claudia

main_line: 做女人几乎是不可能的。你这么美、这么聪明，可你仍觉得自己不够好——这快把我逼疯了。
main_line_en: It is literally impossible to be a woman. You are so beautiful, and so smart, and it kills me that you don't think you're good enough.

main_line: 你是我活下去的全部理由。
main_line_en: You are the reason I am. You are all my reasons.

film_title_en: The Curious Case of Benjamin Button
main_line: 我希望你过上令自己自豪的生活。若发现并非如此，希望你有力量重新开始。
main_line_en: I hope you live a life you're proud of. If you find that you're not, I hope you have the strength to start all over again.

main_line: 想逃，逃不掉。
main_line_en: Want to run — you can’t.

film_title_en: The Bold, the Corrupt, and the Beautiful
main_line: 这世上最脏的生意，往往做在最干净的佛堂里。
main_line_en: The dirtiest deals are often done in the cleanest temples.

film_title_en: I Fell in Love Like a Flower Bouquet
main_line: 我们啊，是最接近恋爱的朋友，也是最接近朋友的恋人。
main_line_en: We were the closest thing to lovers among friends—and the closest thing to friends among lovers.

main_line: 我们都很古怪。只不过有些人更擅长掩饰罢了。
main_line_en: We're all pretty bizarre. Some of us are just better at hiding it, that's all.
main_character: 安德鲁·克拉克 / Andrew Clark

main_line: 弃婴被转手的路上，也可能拼出一家人。
main_line_en: On the road where abandoned babies change hands, a family can still be pieced together.

main_line: 有一天这一切都会结束。
main_line_en: One day all of this will end.
main_character: 科托夫家庭语境 / The Kotov household

main_line: 我想起诉我的父母。
main_line_en: I want to sue my parents.

main_line: 我害怕有一天，你也会把我忘掉。
main_line_en: I'm afraid that one day you'll forget me too.

main_line: 我不认识你，老头。
main_line_en: I know thee not, old man.

main_line: 玫瑰花蕾。
main_line_en: Rosebud.

main_line: 那么——接下来会是什么？
main_line_en: What's it going to be then, eh?

film_title: 上校布林普的生平与死亡
film_title_en: The Life and Death of Colonel Blimp
main_line: 战争从午夜开始。
main_line_en: The war starts at midnight.

main_line: 等我回来。
main_line_en: Wait for me to come back.

main_line: 辩护未必需要真相。
main_line_en: A defense doesn't necessarily need the truth.

main_line: 拍电影的时候，生活反而成了幻觉。
main_line_en: While we make films, life itself becomes the illusion.

main_line: 我不想成为环境的产物——我要让环境成为我的产物。
main_line_en: I don't want to be a product of my environment. I want my environment to be a product of me.

main_line: 一句对不起，要走几十年才说得出口。
main_line_en: One apology can take decades before it can be spoken.
main_character: 刘耀军／李海燕等 / Liu Yaojun / Li Haiyan et al.

main_line: 人和狗之间，有时比人和人之间更像同盟。
main_line_en: Between a man and his dogs, the alliance can feel stronger than among men.

main_line: 我看中的男人，要么是英雄，要么是疯子。
main_line_en: The men I fall for are either heroes—or madmen.

main_line: 梦，是从深处传来的讯息。
main_line_en: Dreams are messages from the deep.

main_line: 岁月是贼——它偷走你的一切，却让你感谢它来过。
main_line_en: Time is a thief—it steals everything, and somehow you still thank it for coming.
main_character: 题旨 / 罗带弟旁白语境

main_line: 不——我才是你的父亲。
main_line_en: No. I am your father.

main_line: 当你爱一样东西，你就会保护它。
main_line_en: When you love something, you protect it.

main_line: 我觉得自己像在掉叶子。
main_line_en: I feel as if I'm losing all my leaves.

main_line: 鱼儿难捕租税重，捕鱼人儿世世穷。
main_line_en: Fish are hard to catch and the tax is heavy — fisherfolk stay poor generation after generation.
main_character: 主题歌 / Theme song 《渔光曲》

main_line: 当生命没有价值时，死亡有时也会有它的价格。
main_line_en: Where life has no value, death, sometimes, has its price.

main_line: 我只想成为我自己。
main_line_en: I only want to become myself.

main_line: 游向大海时，我没有留力气游回来。
main_line_en: I never saved anything for the swim back.

film_title_en: Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire
main_line: 若目标相同、心胸开阔，习惯与语言的差异便不足道。
main_line_en: Differences of habit and language are nothing at all if our aims are identical and our hearts are open.

main_line: 演戏，也是在演历史。
main_line_en: To act is also to act out history.

main_line: 凡是有饥饿的人在争取食物，凡是警察在打人，我都在那里。
main_line_en: Wherever there’s a fight so hungry people can eat, I’ll be there.

main_line: 我想听真话。
main_line_en: I want to hear the truth.

main_line: 上帝，请再帮我救一个。
main_line_en: Please, Lord, help me get one more.

main_line: 煤炭正在杀死我们。
main_line_en: The coal is killing us.
main_character: 矿工家属 / Miners and families

main_line: 原谅我。
main_line_en: Forgive me.

main_line: 我不会为了钱出卖一个孩子。
main_line_en: I will not sell a child for money.

main_line: 似水流年。
main_line_en: Years flow away like water.

main_line: 找到你了，亲爱的。抱歉我来晚了。我找了你好久。
main_line_en: There you are, sweetheart. Sorry I'm late. I was looking everywhere for you.

main_line: 你不必做一个完美的父母，才能做一个好父母。
main_line_en: You don't need to be a perfect parent to be a good parent.

film_title_en: In the Name of the Father
main_line: 我是无辜的！
main_line_en: I am an innocent man!

main_line: 爱是唯一能超越时间与空间的力量。
main_line_en: Love is the one thing we're capable of perceiving that transcends dimensions of time and space.

main_line: 耶利哥的墙——塌了。
main_line_en: The walls of Jericho are toppling!

film_title_en: He Is a Woman, She Is a Man
main_line: 男也好，女也好，我只知道我中意你。
main_line_en: Man or woman—doesn't matter. I only know I love you.

main_line: 生命自会找到出路。
main_line_en: Life finds a way.

main_line: 父亲不来，单车还在；有人愿意等你，路就还通。
main_line_en: Father may not come — the bike remains; if someone will wait for you, the road stays open.
main_character: 西里尔／萨曼莎 / Cyril / Samantha

main_line: 美国佬殖民了我们的潜意识。
main_line_en: The Yankees have colonized our subconscious.

film_title_en: The Bridge on the River Kwai
main_line: 疯狂……疯狂……战争就是这样。
main_line_en: Madness! Madness!

main_line: 你好，克拉丽斯。
main_line_en: Hello, Clarice.

main_line: 没有比武士更孤独的东西，也许只有丛林里的老虎。
main_line_en: There is no greater solitude than that of the samurai, unless perhaps that of the tiger in the jungle.

film_title: 蒙提·派森之布莱恩的一生
main_line: 你们每个人都是独立的个体。
main_line_en: You’re all individuals.

main_line: 怕原子弹的人，难道比不怕的人更疯？
main_line_en: Is the man who fears the bomb more mad than those who do not?

main_line: 没有坏人，只有坏的环境。
main_line_en: There are no bad people, only bad circumstances.

main_line: 快走。
main_line_en: Go. Now.

main_line: 这是一部关于电影语言的实验：不用剧本、不用布景、不用演员，也不借助字幕。
main_line_en: This film is an experiment in cinematic communication of real events without the help of intertitles, without the help of a scenario, without the help of theatre.

main_line: 谢谢你做我的朋友。
main_line_en: Thank you for being my friend.

main_line: 他们想买下这里的一切。
main_line_en: They want to buy everything here.

main_line: 头脑与双手之间，必须有心灵来做调解。
main_line_en: The mediator between the head and the hands must be the heart!

main_line: 微笑吧。
main_line_en: Smile.

main_line: 有些失败的事业，才是唯一值得为之奋斗的事业。
main_line_en: Sometimes lost causes are the only causes worth fighting for.

main_line: 我们还是人。
main_line_en: We are still human.
main_character: 士兵/幸存者群像 / Soldiers and survivors

film_title_en: Prince Nezha's Triumph Against Dragon King
main_line: 我一人做事一人当，不许你们祸害别人！
main_line_en: I alone did the deed—I alone will bear it. You will not harm anyone else!

main_line: 我们同一天出生。
main_line_en: We were born on the same day.
main_character: 奥尔莫与阿尔弗雷多 / Olmo and Alfredo

main_line: 女人的一生，常常不是自己选的路。
main_line_en: A woman's life is so often a road she did not choose.

main_line: 只要活着，就不能停下来。
main_line_en: As long as we live, we cannot stop.

main_line: 规矩破了，人也就废了。
main_line_en: Once the code is broken, the man is finished.

main_line: 天堂若要用尸体铺路，那还是不是天堂？
main_line_en: If paradise is paved with corpses, is it still paradise?

main_line: 大人恋爱时说的谎，小孩在旁边看得一清二楚。
main_line_en: The lies adults tell in love are perfectly clear to the child standing beside them.

film_title_en: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix
main_line: 我们每个人心里都有光明与黑暗。要紧的是你选择按哪一边行事。
main_line_en: We've all got both light and dark inside us. What matters is the part we choose to act on.

film_title_en: A Pigeon Sat on a Branch Reflecting on Existence
main_line: 鸽子停在枝上，思考有没有必要存在。
main_line_en: A pigeon sat on a branch, reflecting on whether existence is necessary.

main_line: 每个人都在寻找自己的位置。
main_line_en: Everyone is looking for their place.

main_line: 想头，也叫理想。人有想头，就什么都有。
main_line_en: What we call hope is also called an ideal. If you have hope, you have everything.

main_line: 我在努力，林戈。我在很努力地想当个牧羊人。
main_line_en: I'm tryin', Ringo. I'm tryin' real hard to be the shepherd.

main_line: 我是个出色的司机。
main_line_en: I'm an excellent driver.

main_line: 当分不清真实与节目，现实就成了最长的试镜。
main_line_en: When you can no longer tell life from the show, reality becomes the longest audition.

main_line: 你为什么想跳舞？——你为什么想活着？
main_line_en: Why do you want to dance? — Why do you want to live?
main_character: 鲍里斯·莱蒙托夫 / 维多利亚·佩吉

main_line: 撬开保险柜的那半小时，谁先出声谁就输。
main_line_en: In the half hour that cracks the safe, the first to speak has already lost.
main_character: 托尼等 / Tony le Stéphanois et al.

main_line: 我不知道该怎么说再见。我想不出任何话来。
main_line_en: I don't know how to say goodbye. I can't think of any words.

main_line: 银幕内外叠在一起，她演的角色终于替她说完遗言。
main_line_en: Screen and life stack together — the role finally speaks the last words she could not.

main_line: 我只想好起来。
main_line_en: I just want to get well.

main_line: 我们必须重新开始。
main_line_en: We have to start again.

main_line: 每到下雪，我就会想起他。
main_line_en: You can still see him when it snows.

main_line: 他知道你是他儿子吗？——可我知道他是我父亲。
main_line_en: Does he know that you are his son? — But I know that he is my dad.

main_line: 如果现实不让我成为英雄，我就在电影里成为英雄。
main_line_en: If reality will not make me a hero, I will become one in the movies.

main_line: 我受够了这个鬼地方。
main_line_en: I’m so fucking sick of this place.

main_line: 我看得见死人。
main_line_en: I see dead people.

main_line: 没有人是完美的。
main_line_en: Well, nobody's perfect.

main_line: 谁都可以戴上面具。你也可以。
main_line_en: Anyone can wear the mask. You can wear the mask.

main_line: 我找人。
main_line_en: I'm looking for someone.

film_title_en: The Boy in the Striped Pajamas
main_line: 我们不该做朋友，你和我。我们本该是敌人。
main_line_en: We're not supposed to be friends, you and me. We're meant to be enemies.

main_line: 我们曾是彼此的阳光。
main_line_en: We were each other's sunshine.

main_line: 一碗拉面的完美，比一场决斗更需要勇气。
main_line_en: The perfection of a bowl of ramen takes more courage than a duel.

main_line: 把孩子卖掉的那一刻，你也把自己卖了。
main_line_en: The moment you sell the child, you sell yourself.

main_line: 我喝你的奶昔！
main_line_en: I drink your milkshake!

main_line: 现在我只有一件事可做：什么也不做。
main_line_en: Now I have only one thing to do: nothing.

main_line: 家园还在日历上，日子却一天天被改写。
main_line_en: Home remains on the calendar, while each day is rewritten.
main_character: 埃利亚·苏莱曼 / Elia Suleiman

main_line: 奇迹总会发生在被遗弃的人身上。
main_line_en: Miracles happen to the abandoned, too—especially on Christmas.
main_character: 题旨 / 银发·阿花·美由纪

main_line: 我们要离开这里，去巴黎。
main_line_en: We are going to leave here, for Paris.

main_line: 如果再也见不到你，祝你早安，午安，晚安。
main_line_en: In case I don't see you… good afternoon, good evening, and good night.

main_line: 哪怕只剩一条狗，人也要活得像个人。
main_line_en: Even with only a dog left, a man must still live like a man.

main_line: 她需要血。必须是人血。你愿意献出自己的血吗？
main_line_en: But she needs blood. It must be human blood. Are you willing to give her your own?

main_line: 那就该在春天下雪。
main_line_en: Then I guess it should snow in spring.

main_line: 没事的，会放晴的。
main_line_en: It's okay — it'll clear up.

main_line: 野蛮，往往是文明人被逼到墙角后的选择。
main_line_en: Savagery is what civilized people choose when they're backed into a corner.

main_line: 没有什么地方比得上家。
main_line_en: There's no place like home.

main_line: 偶尔一点荒唐，连最聪明的人也津津有味。
main_line_en: A little nonsense now and then is relished by the wisest men.

main_line: 电影发明以后，人类的生命延长了三倍。
main_line_en: Movies give us three times as much life.
main_character: NJ（旁白意境） / 杨德昌题旨

main_line: 他们以后再也不会见面了。
main_line_en: They will never meet again.
